summary.headline: Alivus Q2 FY27 revenue rose 16% YoY to INR682 crores and EBITDA margin hit 41.8%, including one-off income; FY27 guidance reiterated at 10-12% growth.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations was INR682 crores, up 16% YoY, with non-GPL business up 20.8% YoY to 79% of revenue. Gross margin reached 64.4% and EBITDA margin 41.8%, both helped by new product launches and one-off income of roughly INR24-25 crores; management put adjusted EBITDA margin at about 39.5%. H1 FY27 revenue was INR1,322 crores (+11.1% YoY) with H1 EBITDA margin of 39.3%. Management reiterated FY27 revenue growth of 10-12% and EBITDA margin of 35-36%, while flagging that GPL volumes will pick up in H2 at lower margins.

financial_highlights.metric: Free cash flow / cash and investments (Sep 30, 2026)
financial_highlights.value: INR270 crores FCF; INR1,012 crores cash incl. short-term investments

segments.name: Non-GPL business
segments.commentary: Grew 20.8% YoY in Q2 and contributes 79% of overall revenue; management expects it at around INR500 crores per quarter for the next couple of quarters, and flattish-to-slightly-lower in Q4 seasonally.

segments.name: GPL business
segments.commentary: Grew only 1% YoY in Q2; FY27 GPL revenue guided at INR700-750 crores with a stronger H2 contribution.

segments.name: Generic API
segments.commentary: Grew 11% YoY in Q2 on demand from regulated and emerging markets.

segments.name: CDMO
segments.commentary: Revenue of INR50 crores in Q2, up 32.3% QoQ and nearly 80% YoY, driven by existing projects (5 active) and newer projects added last year.

segments.name: Therapy mix
segments.commentary: CVS and CNS each contributed 50% of top line; chronic therapies were 67% of Q2 revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance reiterated at 10-12%.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 35-36%; management said gross margin of around 60% should be sustainable going forward.
FY28 EBITDA margin floor of 30-32% if nothing works out; aim is to sustain FY27-level margins.
FY27 GPL revenue expected at INR700-750 crores with H2-weighted contribution.
CDMO revenue to double in 3-4 years, contributing about 12-15% of total revenue (per CFO).
Solapur Phase 1 expected to become operational in Q3 FY27; Taloja R&D centre expected on schedule early next year.
capex_capacity: Q2 FY27 capex INR105 crores; H1 FY27 capex INR190 crores.
Solapur Phase 1 expected operational in Q3 FY27; Solapur to start as backward-integration site for intermediates, with plans to seek US FDA or EU GMP inspection within about a year.
Solapur asset turns expected to approach historical levels in 2-3 years; not in the short term.
Taloja R&D centre construction progressing; on schedule early next year.
Possible formulation oral solids facility decision soon; 18-24 months to build. Flow chemistry: 5 projects to execute commercially in 18-24 months.
demand_pricing: Pricing environment described as stable; erosion was lower in H1 and is factored in; management attributed about 2.5 percentage points of H1 margin expansion to pricing.
Input cost inflation on raw materials largely passed on to customers; solvent costs are 10-12% of raw material basket (7-8% of COGS); crude above $200/bbl is the main headwind.
Freight costs up but a small component; operating costs stable after switching to bio-briquettes from gas.
No business lost due to capacity constraints, though intermediates were a crunch point; CDMO intermediate projects were not entertained earlier.
CDMO ticket size referenced at INR5-7 million per molecule, described as a range.
Over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally; 160-odd US DMFs, of which 90-100 commercial and 60 yet to come off patent.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Q2 was one-off, and will ~60% gross margin hold?
qa_highlights.answer: One-off comprised a validation supply of a complex high-margin product plus a one-off customer income accrual, together about INR24-25 crores. Management expects gross margin around 60% going forward.

qa_highlights.question: How long do new-launch margins last?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said new product margins have a shelf life of about 18-24 months before normalising, which can be offset by continued launches.

qa_highlights.question: How will H2 margins look with higher GPL contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said GPL is a stable margin business, not low margin, and the 35-36% full-year EBITDA guidance still holds; H2 implied growth about 13% and margin about 33% if both ends of guidance are met.

qa_highlights.question: FY28 margin outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Aim to sustain FY27-level margins; floor of 30-32% if nothing works out, citing reasonable visibility for next year.

qa_highlights.question: Is there upside to FY27 guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO confirmed the arithmetic of the upper-end implied H2 numbers, citing GPL pick-up and a subdued non-GPL Q4; no explicit upgrade given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the CDMO outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give a full-year number, said the business is lumpy and tracked yearly, and expects FY27 to be much better than FY26.

qa_highlights.question: What is the solvent and crude exposure?
qa_highlights.answer: Solvents are 10-12% of raw material basket and 7-8% of COGS; crude near $200/bbl would hurt, while bio-briquettes have lowered operating costs versus gas.

qa_highlights.question: Long-term vision and inorganic plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Inorganic options reviewed over the last 15 months, but only synergistic API-platform deals considered; CDMO to double in 3-4 years to 12-15% of revenue.

risks_watch: Gross and EBITDA margin sustainability once one-off income and launch-driven margin premium normalise; adjusted EBITDA margin 39.5% vs reported 41.8%.
Higher GPL share in H2 may dilute margins; Q4 non-GPL seasonally subdued.
Solvent and crude price spikes (crude near $200/bbl cited as a risk) and gas price volatility.
Solapur Phase 1 commissioning in Q3 FY27 and ramp-up, which will weigh on asset turns in the short term.
CDMO revenue is lumpy quarter-to-quarter; management avoided a full-year figure.
Middle East conflict impact on the global environment, as cited by management.
summary.management_tone: Confident on margins and the CDMO trajectory, but guarded on specifics: management declined to give product-level detail, CDMO annual targets, and any upgrade to FY27 guidance, and repeatedly flagged external risks such as crude-linked solvent costs.
key_quotes: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
The margins on newly launched products have a sort of shelf life, should I say, right, of maybe 18 to 24 months, and then it starts normalizing.
CDMO, I agree with you. It's not a quarter-on-quarter thing. So one should not assume that we'll just keep hammering away.
So we are okay, but the gas -- like I said, crude prices could impact solvents, and that will have quite a good -- quite a significant impact on our cost structure.

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth of 10-12% reiterated (midpoint 11%) with Q2 revenue +16% YoY and H1 +11.1%; GPL guided at INR700-750 crores H2-weighted and Solapur Phase 1 due Q3 FY27, but no order-book or utilisation figures given, so backing is partial and the H2 non-GPL outlook is flat-to-slightly-lower.
